title.narrative: Support to the Government of Viet Nam in the preparation of an Industrial Strategy and of the related Implementation Policy

description.narrative: The Government of Viet Nam emphasizes the need to speed up Viet Nam#s industrialization process through value addition and technological upgrading. The Ministry of Industry and Trade (MoIT) of Viet Nam recently released Viet Nam#s industry development strategy to 2025, with a vision to 2035, which identified three main industries (manufacturing and processing, telecommunication and electronics, new and renewable energy) and the priority sub-sectors in manufacturing industry focusing on the development of high value-added industry and industries which have strong backward and forward linkages. Prior to the release of this strategy, MoIT, with the support of UNIDO, produced the Viet Nam Industrial Competitiveness Report (VICR) 2011, which gave theoretical underpinnings and key recommendations to the above strategy. On the basis of the successful collaboration in the VICR 2011 and the subsequent release of the industrial strategy, the Government of Viet Nam is now keen on launching a new cooperation project with UNIDO which can contribute to the upgrading of industrial competitiveness in terms of further detailing its strategy into sub-sector level as well as enhancing its implementation to a set of industrial policies targeted at the promotion of priority sectors and value chains.
